description: This file implements a doubly linked list library with functions for initialization, insertion, removal, and moving list items.

methods.name: DLLIST_Init
methods.description: Initializes a doubly linked list by setting head and tail to NULL.

methods.name: DLLIST_IsItemInList
methods.description: Checks if a given item is present in the list; used for debug purposes.

methods.name: DLLIST_LinkToHead
methods.description: Adds an item to the head of the list.

methods.name: DLLIST_LinkToTail
methods.description: Adds an item to the tail of the list.

methods.name: DLLIST_Unlink
methods.description: Removes an item from the list without freeing memory.

methods.name: DLLIST_InsertLinkBefore
methods.description: Inserts an item before a specified item in the list.

methods.name: DLLIST_MoveLink
methods.description: Moves an item from one list to the tail of another list.
